summary: Iteration 4 (Phase 2 — real client-side run ingestion) frontend e2e testing complete. 8 of 11 acceptance items PASS end-to-end; 3 critical issues identified that block the corresponding pages or violate spec. Real-data flow is working for IMPORT, OVERVIEW, RUN DETAIL, COMPARISON LAB, RUNS toggle, PERSISTENCE, REMOVE, VALIDATION FAILURE. BLOCKERS: (1) Strategy Map crashes on render with 'hasCandles is not defined' ReferenceError → blank page (body_len=18). (2) Trade Inspector crashes with 'AlertTriangle is not defined' → no-candles banner never renders + trade list absent. (3) Runs page does NOT order imported runs first — default sort=netR overrides the imported-first list ordering, so EURUSD_M15_RR4 (+55R mock) appears first instead of the imported +2.6R run. Toggle hide-mocks itself works correctly. Computed real metrics match analytical truth: Profit Factor=(3+3)/(1+1+1+1)=1.50 ✓, Max Drawdown=-2.0R (cumulative path peak 4 → trough 2) ✓, Net R from summary=+2.6R ✓, Win Rate=33.3% ✓.

ui_bugs.issue: PAGEERROR: 'hasCandles is not defined'. Page renders blank (body_len=18). Same destructure-from-useDataset() bug pattern as iteration-2 SweepLab and iteration-3 ComparisonLab. The component references `hasCandles` but the identifier was never destructured from useDataset() or computed from active run candles. Acceptance check [data-testid=map-no-candles-banner] cannot be verified because the route throws on mount.

PAGEERROR: 'AlertTriangle is not defined'. The no-candles banner JSX references the AlertTriangle lucide icon but it is NOT in the import line at the top of TradeInspector.jsx. Result: [data-testid=ti-no-candles-banner] is_visible() = false, and the 6 imported trades T-001..T-006 are absent from the left list because the component error-boundaries out. Add `AlertTriangle` to the existing `import { ... } from 'lucide-react'`.
ui_bugs.selector: /trade-inspector — ReferenceError + missing banner + empty trade list

ui_bugs.issue: Imported run NOT first in table. Default sort is by netR descending, so EURUSD_M15_RR4 (+55R mock) sits at row 1 and the imported +2.6R run is buried. Spec requires imported runs first regardless of sort. Fix: in Runs.jsx filtered useMemo, partition by _source first (imported group, then mock group), then apply sort within each partition. Current sort logic does not honor the imported-first ordering produced by store.buildDerived. Toggle 'Hide Mock Runs' works correctly (only the 1 imported row remains).
ui_bugs.selector: [data-testid=runs-table] tbody tr — first row should have REAL pill

ui_bugs.issue: Persistent 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on initial render. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/StrategyMap.jsx: either destructure `hasCandles` from useDataset() (store exposes it via `active?.hasCandles` — add to buildDerived return) or derive locally e.g. `const hasCandles = (CANDLES?.length ?? 0) > 0`. Currently blanks the route.
Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/TradeInspector.jsx: add `AlertTriangle` to the lucide-react import line. The icon is referenced inside the no-candles banner JSX but not imported.

Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/Runs.jsx ordering: imported runs must appear before mock runs regardless of sort column. Suggested patch: split filtered into [imp = filtered.filter(r=>r._source==='imported'), mock = filtered.filter(r=>r._source!=='imported')], sort each independently, return [...imp, ...mock].

Audit other refactored pages (SweepLab, MonteCarlo, ParityDebugger) for the same scope-after-refactor pattern — three iterations in a row have surfaced ReferenceError bugs from undeclared identifiers used inside route components. An error boundary around <Outlet /> would have surfaced these earlier.
critical_code_review_comments: Pattern: Three regressions in three iterations (SweepLab→ComparisonLab→StrategyMap+TradeInspector) all caused by missing imports or missing destructured store keys. This is a systemic issue — recommend adding ESLint no-undef rule (likely already on, but possibly suppressed) and an error boundary around each routed page so one broken page does not white-out the entire route. Add a CI smoke-test that visits every route and asserts body_len > 100 + no pageerrors.

importer.js correctly validates required artifacts and returns {ok:false, missing:[...]} when fields are absent; store.js correctly persists to localStorage and exposes hasImportedRuns flag — these flows are robust.

store.buildDerived returns RUNS as [...importedList, ...mockList] (imported first), but Runs.jsx loses this ordering by re-sorting on a single numeric key. Either preserve the partition in Runs.jsx or expose two separate arrays from the store.
ImportZone error title 'Bundle incomplete' is rendered uppercased via CSS (`uppercase tracking-wider`) — DOM text is 'BUNDLE INCOMPLETE'. Tests asserting on visible text should be case-insensitive.
seed_data_creation: Used existing /app/sample_run_bundle/* fixtures (config.json + summary.json + order_blocks.csv + trades_single_position.csv).

(b) /trade-inspector banner missing — 'AlertTriangle is not defined' ReferenceError; trade list also empty. (c) /runs default ordering DOES NOT put imported first — sort=netR makes EURUSD_M15_RR4 (+55R mock) appear at row 1 instead of the imported +2.6R run.
rca of the issue: (1) StrategyMap.jsx — ReferenceError 'hasCandles is not defined'. Same class of bug as iter-2 SweepLab and iter-3 ComparisonLab: page references an identifier that was never declared (neither imported nor destructured from useDataset()). MITIGATION: destructure `hasCandles` from store (need to expose it via buildDerived: `hasCandles: !!active?.hasCandles`) OR compute locally `const hasCandles = (CANDLES?.length ?? 0) > 0`. (2) TradeInspector.jsx — ReferenceError 'AlertTriangle is not defined'. The icon is referenced inside the no-candles banner JSX but not added to the existing `import { … } from 'lucide-react'` line. MITIGATION: add AlertTriangle to the lucide-react import. (3) Runs.jsx ordering — store.buildDerived returns RUNS pre-sorted with imported-first, but Runs.jsx filtered useMemo re-sorts the merged array by a single numeric key (default 'netR') which collapses the imported partition into the mock partition. MITIGATION: partition first by _source before sorting, e.g. `const imp = arr.filter(r=>r._source==='imported').sort(cmp); const mock = arr.filter(r=>r._source!=='imported').sort(cmp); return [...imp, ...mock];`.
